audit.executionBoundary: No MCP connection, service start, API request or generation has occurred during this dry check.

tools.name: aftertake_editing_guide
tools.description: Discover the narration-first editing workflow, actual plan schema, constraints and review steps.

tools.name: aftertake_workspace
tools.description: List local film pictures, voice clips, finished takes and exports. IDs and hashes identify media roles; source clips must be imported as film media before use.

tools.name: aftertake_import_media
tools.description: Import one selected local file for Film editing or studio generation. Paths stay under the configured media root; identical verified bytes are reused. Studio stills are normalized by the same native importer as the UI. No network media URL is accepted.

tools.name: aftertake_voice
tools.description: Voice a short beat locally before choosing its picture duration. Set timedWords:true for model word timings used by spoken titles. Exact script/voice/speed/timing requests are reused. A busy/timeout response is not permission to launch a duplicate.

tools.name: aftertake_inspect_picture
tools.description: Inspect decoded frames from one Film asset, studio source/generated media, or completed take before choosing trims. Returns the actual content hash and review images; preserves source orientation.

tools.name: aftertake_save_plan
tools.description: Compile and persist an editable, content-bound beat plan. Rejects insufficient footage, changed media and overlapping narration; it never truncates a voice or stretches a shot. Does not render.

tools.name: aftertake_detect_beats
tools.description: Estimate the tempo, beat and likely downbeat times (source seconds) of an imported music or video asset. Place the track on the film timeline, then end shots on beats: a styled transition switches pictures at the midpoint of its dissolve overlap, so center that overlap on the beat. Results are cached by content hash; review the cut by ear.

tools.name: aftertake_save_film_edit
tools.description: Save a complete editable native Film project with cuts, camera keyframes, animated text, shape/image graphic layers and audio. Format 4 motionScene supports ordered one-level groups of titles and graphics with a shared pivot, editable transforms, perspective depth and bounded shutter samples. Format 5 adds punch title animations (slam, pop, reveal, glitch, scramble), display/condensed/mono fonts, stamp/highlight/underline boxes, tilt, and styled shot transitions (whip, zoom, flash, glitch, slide) played over each shot’s dissolve seconds. Verifies source hashes and timing without rendering. Revise the project to create a new plan ID; export and review through the same plan tools.

tools.name: aftertake_export_plan
tools.description: Export a saved plan through the real native Film renderer. Repeating planId/attempt returns the same job. Increment attempt only after an observed failed export; a timeout is not failure.

tools.name: aftertake_plan_status
tools.description: Read authoritative native export state for a saved plan. An empty result means no recorded admission was found, not that any timed-out work was canceled.

tools.name: aftertake_review_film
tools.description: Decode an actual completed export and return review frames, audio diagnostics and embedded-project verification. Frame images support visual inspection; metrics alone do not certify editing or generation quality.

tools.name: aftertake_draft_script
tools.description: Draft one short spoken line per described picture using the optional local open-weight script model. Returns a persisted native draft job. Keep the exact request to rejoin after a timeout. This model sees text descriptions; review its factual details before using its suggestions in a film.

tools.name: aftertake_script_status
tools.description: Observe the same native script draft by ID. Returns actual proposed lines and the local model receipt when complete; it does not apply text, voice it or start a new draft.

tools.name: aftertake_rejoin_script
tools.description: Rejoin a script draft interrupted by studio restart, retaining its original request and result cache. The local worker lock prevents a second inference for that same draft if its original process is still finishing.

tools.name: aftertake_generation_workspace
tools.description: List generation source clips and actual image, frame-edit and video jobs, plus the editable starter recipes for each kind. Optionally check one local model profile. This reads native state and starts no generation.

tools.name: aftertake_generate_image
tools.description: Create a real Z-Image Turbo image through the native Comfy SDK workflow. Give this deliberate operation a stable requestId; keep the same ID and inputs after a timeout or reconnect.

tools.name: aftertake_generate_video
tools.description: Generate native LTX-2.5 video directly from text, with optional synchronized model-generated sound. No source image or footage is used. Keep the same requestId and inputs after timeouts; inspect the resulting clip before Film handoff.

tools.name: aftertake_edit_frame
tools.description: Create a Qwen edited frame from a canonical studio source and optional subject reference. Keep the same requestId and inputs when rejoining; inspect the resulting image before using it as a video guide.

tools.name: aftertake_render_take
tools.description: Render a real native video recipe: reference animation, painted region editing, or motion transfer. Uses the same asset validation, model profiles, SDK workflow and reviewed output path as the UI. Give each deliberate revision its own requestId.

tools.name: aftertake_generation_status
tools.description: Rejoin a persisted generation by kind and the original requestId, including after reconnect. Reads actual native state; a timeout is not cancellation and no new generation starts.

tools.name: aftertake_generation_action
tools.description: Cancel an active generation or reconcile a recorded uncertain admission using its original native job/key. Reconciliation never changes its inputs. Use status to observe completion; terminal records are retained.

tools.name: aftertake_use_source
tools.description: Bring a canonical studio image or video, including a completed character take, into Film without changing its bytes. Requires the inspected source hash and reuses an existing verified film asset. Ordinary video takes can also be used directly by renderId.

tools.name: aftertake_character_workspace
tools.description: Inspect character replacement profiles, studio sources/photos, saved person selections and completed character takes. Track a person, inspect the actual overlay, then replace them from an original reference photo.

tools.name: aftertake_track_character
tools.description: Track a user-selected person with native SAM3 and save a lossless mask plus review video. Keep this requestId and the original inputs to rejoin the same SDK job.

tools.name: aftertake_replace_character
tools.description: Replace the reviewed person using native H3 Character Swap V1.5. Supply the inspected mask hash, primary photo and optional supporting identityReferences. Source performance, likeness, articulation and scene preservation require visual review; original source audio is retained when present.

tools.name: aftertake_character_status
tools.description: Rejoin a recorded character job by its stable requestId or native record id. Reading status never launches another generation.

tools.name: aftertake_character_action
tools.description: Cancel active character work or reconcile an uncertain submission/output download using its original record and SDK key. Does not create a replacement job.

tools.name: aftertake_inspect_character
tools.description: Decode real review frames from a completed SAM3 overlay or H3 take. Inspect the selected person, fingers, hair, props and background before accepting a mask or using the result.

tools.name: aftertake_character_recipe
tools.description: Retrieve the source-bound selection, original primary/supporting references and crops, seed, SDK job id, actual executed graph and output hash for a character take.

tools.name: aftertake_effects_workspace
tools.description: Inspect saved subject, finishing, still-image depth and layered-image jobs, plus imported image assets. Layer compositing, reusing a completed person selection and color finishing are CPU pixel operations. Estimating new depth requires the native CUDA BF16 engine.

tools.name: aftertake_depth_effect
tools.description: Apply depth-based lens blur, atmospheric haze and a directional virtual light to one still image. DA3 Small estimates real depth on native CUDA BF16; pixel effects retain the source canvas. No video depth support. Inspect the depth and finished image before using it as an animation reference.

tools.name: aftertake_duplicate_subject
tools.description: Copy the reviewed person into up to four offset, scaled, rotated or flipped positions, retaining source sound once. Optional copy.color makes a solid hex-color silhouette; copy.behindSubject keeps the current tracked person in front, for colored mask echoes. Optional blur/exposure affects the background. No diffusion or identity regeneration. Review cutout edges and occlusion in the output.

tools.name: aftertake_finish_media
tools.description: Save a color-finished image or video with editable, hash-bound settings: exposure, contrast, white balance, eight-channel HSL, master/RGB curves, an imported display-sRGB .cube LUT, film look, sharpness, optical effects, vignette and grain. Retains original video timing and audio. An active LUT needs its exact companion file already imported in Color & finish. Does not alter generated object geometry.

tools.name: aftertake_effect_status
tools.description: Read an existing subject, finishing, still-image depth or layer-stack job by record ID or stable requestId. Status can resume tracking accepted work; it never submits a new generation.

tools.name: aftertake_compose_layers
tools.description: Compose up to eight still-image and adjustment layers with 27 blend modes, opacity, transforms, clipping and shape or image masks. Request layers are bottom first. Uses exact imported image-asset SHA256 bindings and the shared color pipeline; does not generate images or process video layers. Read status before retrying after a timeout. Save the recipe and exact image/mask companions for reproduction.

tools.name: aftertake_resolve_layers
tools.description: Rebind a portable layer-stack recipe to matching imported image assets by exact SHA256, without composing or generating anything. Import all source and mask images first; UUIDs can differ between machines. Returns a validated request for preview or composition.

tools.name: aftertake_preview_layers
tools.description: Inspect the actual composited still-image PNG using the same layers, masks, transforms, blend modes and adjustment pipeline as export. Does not save a finished clip. Review transparency, edges and color before composing.

tools.name: aftertake_depth_action
tools.description: Cancel accepted depth estimation or reconcile its uncertain connection using the original stable request key. Recovery never changes its source or settings.

tools.name: aftertake_effect_recipe
tools.description: Read an editable effect recipe and its media bindings. A subject recipe requires original source, prepared video and lossless tracked mask; keep all three exact hashes when moving workspaces.

tools.name: aftertake_cancel_finishing
tools.description: Cancel an active local color-finishing export. This stops its worker; read the returned status before reusing the output.

tools.name: aftertake_preview_finish
tools.description: Inspect an actual processed frame with the same settings and pixel pipeline as a final finishing export. Returns a PNG for visual review. Does not create a finished clip or certify the whole video.

tools.name: aftertake_refine_blend
tools.description: Refine a completed native region VFX or masked edit using its saved raw generation. Changes only the final painted area and source color matching, preserving source timing and audio. Runs CPU pixel composition without invoking a model or the Comfy graph. The original take remains. Omit compositeRegion to restore its generation region. Keep a stable requestId and read status before retrying after a timeout; inspect the completed output before using it in Film.

tools.name: aftertake_blend_status
tools.description: Read a saved CPU blend refinement by record ID or original requestId. Returns its separate processing receipt and completed take when available; never regenerates or restarts work.

tools.name: aftertake_cancel_blend
tools.description: Cancel an existing CPU blend refinement. Keeps the original take and saved raw generation; does not submit another job.

image.label: Fashion editorial
image.description: A clean fashion concept with a full outfit and room for your own campaign copy.

settings.prompt: An adult fashion model wearing a tailored cobalt-blue jacket, ivory trousers and simple dark shoes, standing naturally against a warm grey studio wall. Show the complete outfit and both hands. Gentle side light reveals the fabric texture. A restrained editorial composition with clear space beside the model for copy. No lettering, logos or watermarks.

image.label: Clean product still
image.description: A simple studio product concept with controlled light and an uncluttered surface.

settings.prompt: One unbranded brushed-aluminium reusable bottle standing on a matte off-white tabletop against a seamless pale-grey background. Keep the bottle geometry straight and its material crisp. A large soft key light from the left and subtle fill create a grounded contact shadow and gentle reflections. Minimal composition, no extra props, no text, no logo.

image.label: Lifestyle scene
image.description: A product in use in a lived-in place, with natural light and a human touch.

settings.prompt: One unbranded matte-black ceramic pour-over coffee set on a worn oak kitchen counter in the morning. Steam rises from a fresh cup, an adult hand rests beside it, and a window behind the counter fills the room with low warm sunlight. Linen towel, a small plant and a few coffee beans give the scene life without crowding the product, which stays sharp and clearly the subject. Natural colors, believable clutter, no text or logos.

image.label: Hands close-up
image.description: A tight demonstration shot: adult hands holding or applying the product.

settings.prompt: Extreme close-up of an adult's hands holding a small unbranded amber glass dropper bottle and releasing one clear drop onto the fingertips. Natural skin texture with visible fine detail, short clean nails, a soft cream sweater cuff at the edge of frame. The bottle label area is blank. Bright diffused light, creamy out-of-focus background in warm neutrals, tack-sharp focus on the drop. No faces, text or logos.

image.label: Moodboard pin
image.description: A soft, styled flat-lay with a curated palette. Choose Portrait for a pin-shaped frame.

settings.prompt: A styled overhead flat-lay in a muted sage, sand and terracotta palette: an unbranded linen notebook, a ceramic cup of matcha, dried pampas stems, a brass pen and a folded knit scarf arranged with generous breathing room on a textured plaster surface. Gentle window light with soft shadows, calm editorial mood, everything in focus. No text, logos or watermarks.

image.label: Hero banner
image.description: A wide campaign header with the product on one side and clear space for a headline. Choose Landscape.

settings.prompt: A wide cinematic campaign image: one unbranded white running shoe resting on a wet black stone ledge in the right third of the frame, lit by a cool rim light, with fine mist and soft dawn light over a blurred mountain lake behind it. The left two thirds stay calm and uncluttered, a smooth gradient of sky and water ready for a headline. Premium, minimal and crisp. No text, logos or watermarks.

image.label: Conceptual splash
image.description: A sculptural, frozen-motion product shot: levitation, splash and studio color.

settings.prompt: One unbranded frosted glass perfume bottle floating mid-air at a slight tilt, surrounded by a frozen crown splash of clear water and a few suspended citrus slices, against a saturated tangerine studio backdrop. Crisp droplets catch a hard key light, the bottle casts a soft shadow on the seamless floor below. High-speed photography look, sharp from front to back, bold and playful. No text, logos or watermarks.

video.label: Product showcase
video.description: A polished hero turn around a product on a lit plinth. No presenter.

settings.prompt: An unbranded brushed-steel wristwatch rests on a slowly rotating black stone plinth in a dark studio. A thin rim light traces its edge, reflections glide across the polished case, and the second hand ticks smoothly. Fine dust drifts through a single soft spotlight. Premium, calm and tack sharp. No text or logos.

video.label: TV spot
video.description: A broadcast-style moment: a crafted scene, warm light and a confident push in.

settings.prompt: Golden evening in a sunlit family kitchen. An adult in a denim shirt pours fresh orange juice from an unbranded glass carafe into a tall glass, the juice catching the light, then lifts the glass toward the window with a satisfied smile. Lens flare from the low sun, warm wood tones, shallow depth of field, the polish of a broadcast commercial. Gentle ambient kitchen sound, no dialogue. No text or logos.

video.label: Phone-filmed UGC
video.description: An organic, filmed-on-a-phone feel: a person reacting to a product at home.

settings.prompt: Filmed on a phone propped on a bookshelf in a bright apartment. A young adult in a grey hoodie sits on a sofa, holds up an unbranded mint-green water bottle toward the lens, takes a sip, and nods with an easy, genuine grin. Everyday window light, slightly imperfect framing, natural colors and real-life texture rather than studio polish. Quiet room tone, no dialogue. No text or logos.

video.label: Unboxing reveal
video.description: Overhead hands opening a box and lifting the product into view.

settings.prompt: Top-down view of a light oak desk. Adult hands lift the lid off a plain matte-white gift box, fold back crisp tissue paper, and raise a pair of unbranded charcoal wireless headphones up into the light. Soft daylight from one side, a small plant and a notebook at the frame edges. Satisfying, tactile and clean. Soft paper rustle sound, no dialogue. No text or logos.

video.label: How-to demo
video.description: A clear tutorial beat: hands showing one step, close and well lit.

settings.prompt: Close shot of adult hands on a pale marble counter pressing the plunger of an unbranded glass French press down in one slow, steady motion, the dark coffee swirling below the mesh. Bright, even daylight, a clean neutral background, every movement easy to follow. The camera eases slowly closer. Faint pour and press sounds, no dialogue. No text or logos.

video.label: Neon teaser
video.description: A moody launch teaser: rain, neon reflections and a slow reveal.

settings.prompt: Night in a rain-soaked city alley. Neon light in magenta and cyan ripples across puddles as the view slowly sweeps past steaming vents toward a sleek unbranded electric scooter parked under a single flickering sign. Raindrops streak through the light, reflections shimmer on its glossy body. Tense, stylish and cinematic. Rain and distant city hum, no dialogue. No text or logos.

frame.label: Warm practical relight
frame.description: Prompt-guided still relight using the current frame model. Keep the source composition. Detailed · 20 steps.

settings.prompt: Relight Picture 1 with a restrained warm evening atmosphere. Let existing lamps or windows motivate the illumination, with soft amber highlights and natural shadow falloff. Preserve the people, identities, expressions, clothing, object shapes, camera framing and background arrangement. Keep skin tones believable. Do not add a lamp, change the time of day dramatically or introduce bloom.

frame.label: Product replacement
frame.description: Use your selected subject image as Picture 2. Edit the product instruction before running. Detailed · 20 steps.

settings.prompt: Replace the main foreground product in Picture 1 with the product shown in Picture 2. Use Picture 2 for the product shape, material and colors only. Match the original product placement, scale, perspective, illumination, contact shadow and any visible reflections in Picture 1. Preserve every person, hand, surrounding prop, background and the camera framing. Do not copy the background or lighting of Picture 2. Keep existing lettering faithful; do not invent new text.

frame.label: Preserve-source monochrome
frame.description: Ask for a restrained black-and-white treatment while keeping the composition. Detailed · 20 steps.

settings.prompt: Convert Picture 1 to a natural black-and-white photographic treatment with smooth midtones, retained highlight detail and gently deeper blacks. Preserve all people, facial identity, poses, clothing, object geometry, background, original framing and visible texture. Change the color treatment only. Do not add film damage, grain, blur, vignette, text or new objects.

frame.label: Seasonal restyle
frame.description: Move the same scene into a snowy winter evening without changing who or what is in it. Detailed · 20 steps.

settings.prompt: Restyle Picture 1 as a quiet winter evening: a light layer of fresh snow on outdoor surfaces, a few soft falling flakes, cool blue ambient light balanced by warm windows or practical lights. Preserve every person, facial identity, pose, clothing, object geometry, camera framing and the layout of the scene. Change only the season, weather and light. Do not add new people, objects, text or logos.

frame.label: Outfit try-on
frame.description: Dress the person in Picture 1 in the garment from your selected subject image. Detailed · 20 steps.

settings.prompt: Dress the main person in Picture 1 in the garment shown in Picture 2. Use Picture 2 only for the garment's cut, fabric, color and details, and fit it naturally to the person's body, pose and proportions with believable folds. Preserve the person's face, identity, hair, skin tone, hands, pose, the background and the camera framing. Match the lighting and shadows of Picture 1. Do not change any other clothing unless the new garment covers it, and do not add text or logos.

structuredContent.note: Starters hold editable prompt and look settings: merge one into a request and supply your own name, aspect, seed and media. A completed take can be used by renderId in a film plan. Text-to-video returns a source clipId; use aftertake_use_source to bring it, another source or a generated still into Film.
